Scammell, Elson, Field and Carne are to be congratulated on their fine performance, and most of us were especially pleased to see Jack Carne in the scoring four after so many disappointments in previous "Juniors."
McMullen, Hyde, Pope, Scammell, Green, Fletcher and Holland were the most prominent. Our 'A' team packed in fine fashion to win the scratch team race (3,6,7,9).
